input.instruction: Answer the customer’s policy question using the supplied records and handbook. Complete the requested fields and provide a concise explanation. This is an informational request; propose no account or claim actions.

messages.text: My camera was stolen from the locked room I rented for a three-night trip. It is my camera, not the host’s. Does my renters policy stop applying once I leave my apartment?
When did the theft happen, and are you asking about coverage scope or to open a claim?
October 6, 2026. Just explain the scope for now; I will gather the details before opening anything.

event_date.description: Reported event date in ISO format.

property_scope.description: Whether this reported property/event meets the supplied base ownership, cause and timing scope; this is not a claim decision.

away_from_home_disqualifies.description: Whether temporary absence from the insured home alone disqualifies these belongings.

claim_requested.description: Whether the customer has requested claim intake in this chat.
